invariants.rationale: The method likely requires a non-null instantTime to identify the operation timestamp.
A list of partitions to delete should not be null; if it were null, the method would likely error before any processing.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is likely required for method execution.
The size of a collection is always non-negative; empty lists are supported.
If partitions is empty, its size is zero (relationship between .isEmpty and .size).
